snippet.title: Official Trailer – Summoner’s Tale (Wishlist on Steam!)
snippet.description:
Step into a world where monsters and humans share a fragile balance.
In Summoner’s Tale, you play as Noa, a young summoner who must uncover the truth, forge bonds with powerful monsters, and protect both worlds from chaos.

This is your first look at our official trailer — showcasing the story, companions, combat, and the journey ahead.
Welcome to the beginning of your summoner’s path.

🌟 Wishlist Summoner’s Tale on Steam

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081350/Summoner_Tale/

💬 Join the Community

Discord: https://discord.gg/JmEerRsatv

🔵 Follow Our Dev Journey

Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/negmworld.bsky.social


🐾 About the Game

Summoner’s Tale is an indie monster-taming action RPG where you:

Befriend unique monster companions

Explore forests, mountains, lakes, and more!

Uncover a story of treason, guardians, and ancient power

Fight enemies using fast action combat

Evolve monsters through multiple forms

Choose your squad from Companions, Attackers, Supporters, and Enhancers

Whether you love monster-taming, action RPGs, or narrative-driven adventures, Summoner’s Tale is crafted for you.

❤️ Thank you for supporting a small indie team!

Your wishlist, comment, or share helps more than you can imagine.
Let’s build this world together!
